review.why: Builds, migrates and deploys Next.js apps on Cloudflare Workers with vinext, which is preferred over OpenNext for new projects.
review.summary: States the default (vinext, not OpenNext, for new projects) and why: Next.js APIs on Vite with native Workers integration and incremental migration. It tells the agent to install the upstream vinext skills if missing and follow them, with separate paths for a new project and an existing Next.js project, and warns not to assume full Next.js parity.
strengths: Clear default and a reason for it
Preserves existing OpenNext setups during unrelated work
Warns that compatibility must be checked for required features
cautions: Mostly delegates to upstream skills it tells the agent to install
